subset_rule: First ids by seeded SHA-256 when --questions is smaller than 299
donor_rule: Seeded cyclic derangement of questions; first listed donor answer; matched prefix step, then carried forward from final available position; all deltas scaled to recipient RMS
branch_rule: Clamp both additive attention and MLP writes at every suffix layer and all positions, with matched native references from the same causal candidate sequence. Keep direct residual.
rotation_rule: One seeded signed coordinate permutation shared across K1–K4.
